I've answered Tobias in a thread under his message: the depot was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from Priyanka's updates in #inc-tansley-carrier-api on 3 Sep 2025. While labels were stalled, Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. When the incident was resolved later that day, she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address or site code for Southgate. Neither the incident channel nor the shared files Tobias can see have one, and there's no Tansley account folder. I suggested he ask Priyanka if he needs more than the depot name.
